quests.title: Herbalist's Forage

dialogue.t: Hmm? Oh yes, you must've seen the commission I posted. Have you gathered the ten Mint leaves yet?

dialogue.sit: Yes, I have them right here.

dialogue.t: Ah yes, the Mint. Let's see... Right, this should be enough.
Here, these are for you. Thanks again for your help.

quests.description: Liyue Harbor’s Herbalist Gui needs ten Mints.
